body:
Phase 0 — Dendro Release 1 (v0.1.0). Sponsor Go-Ahead 2026-10-10 16:56Z. PM decision: proceed.

Job Statement: When I operate an agent team (rig) that has worked for days, I want to see where time, tokens and rework actually went, by seat, handoff and mission, so I can change topology, handoffs or budget with evidence, not intuition.

Struggling moment: a mission is slow or expensive and the operator cannot say why. Data exists (openrig.sqlite: 208 queue items, 702 transitions, 4169 usage samples; ~180 MB harness logs) but nothing joins cost to seat, handoff or mission. Alternatives fail: transcripts are one seat at a time; provider dashboards are per account; manual SQL lacks tokens; cloud APMs need export and do not model seats.

Observable outcome (G1): O1 first answer within 5 min from existing local logs; O2-O4 answer seat, handoff, cost questions for a named rig and period; O5 every number traces to its source record; O6 re-run does not duplicate totals; O7 no raw prompts or secrets stored; O8 sponsor takes a real decision on dendro-dev or agentflow-dev using seat ROI, handoff efficiency, QA->Build rework and skill impact.

Scope for this squad: G1 engine. Harnesses: OpenRig, Claude Code, Codex required; AGY, Pi, Grok next in the same release. Site, brand and the three docs are parallel, owned by Antigravity, outside this squad.

Constraints: local-first, read-only on sources, no raw transcripts or secrets, stack Rust + DuckDB + Nao (sponsor decision), unknown source formats warn and never corrupt.
Anti-goals: not SaaS/cloud APM; does not control agents; does not judge code quality; does not guess links.

Release intent: v0.1.0, impact minor, local build, no publication.

Unknowns for analyst: idle definition; handoff context cost; loop definition; seat ROI without judging code quality; skill-impact measurability; session-to-seat linking confidence.

References: docs/PRODUCT_SPECIFICATION.md, .agentflow/PRODUCT.md, docs/INTAKE_BRIEFING.md, docs/research/openrig-discussion-1099.md.
